sources.quote: Gamma Boötis is a binary star system in the northern constellation of Boötes the herdsman, forming the left shoulder of this asterism.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 32 times the Sun's luminosity at 7,793 K, so 3.109 solar radii.
